Yet, every solution seems to rely on Stripe or PayPal, leaving you with hefty fees and limited access to your customer base. You're not alone. This post will break down the exact [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-selling-notion-templates-crypto-stripe|The Full]] to sell beats online with crypto payments, without relying on Stripe or any other payment platforms.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Beats online

This is not just another workaround or a hack to bypass Stripe or PayPal's restrictions. This is a sovereign digital commerce infrastructure that empowers you to build, deploy, and scale your online store, complete with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. You're not renting a service or subscribing to a platform; you're building your own infrastructure, free from third-party control.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture is built around a combination of free and paid tools, including GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. Each component plays a crucial role in enabling automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. GitHub Pages provides hosting, Cloudflare Workers handles backend logic, Supabase stores orders, and NOWPayments verifies payments. This stack is designed to be scalable, secure, and cost-effective.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is built specifically for digital creators like you, who face restrictions on Stripe or PayPal in countries like Zimbabwe, Pakistan, Bangladesh, or the Philippines. You may be selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, software, or digital products, but struggle to collect payments through conventional platforms. This solution is tailored to your needs, providing a sovereign digital commerce stack that you can deploy, manage, and scale with ease.
You can save up to $921 in fees compared to Gumroad with NOWPayments.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Each component in this stack is carefully chosen to work seamlessly with the others. GitHub Pages provides a free hosting solution, while Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic and automatic crypto payment processing. Supabase stores orders securely, and NOWPayments verifies payments in real-time. This stack is designed to be modular, allowing you to add or remove components as needed. With the Complete Builder Kit, you'll have everything you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this infrastructure today, follow these steps: purchase the Complete Builder Kit ($197), download the blueprints and templates, and start building your sovereign digital commerce stack. Set up GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment verification. Deploy your stack on Cloudflare Pages, and configure SPF, DKIM, and DMARC for email deliverability. With the Complete Builder Kit, you'll have everything you need to deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack in no time.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
This infrastructure is modular, allowing you to add or remove components as needed.

If you're looking for a way to sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, software, or digital products online without relying on Stripe or PayPal, this post has you covered. Deploy your stack on Cloudflare Pages, configure SPF, DKIM, and DMARC for email deliverability, and start selling your digital products online.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I integrate NOWPayments with my existing website?

Integrating NOWPayments with your existing website is a straightforward process. You'll need to add a small code snippet to your website, which will enable automatic crypto payment verification. With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, and USDT, and convert payments to USD in real-time.
What are the fees associated with using NOWPayments?

NOWPayments charges a flat fee of 0.5% per transaction, which is significantly lower than most payment platforms. With this fee structure, you can retain 100% of your earnings, minus the transaction fee. With 100 sales per month on a $97 product, you can save up to $921 in fees compared to Gumroad.

Yes, this infrastructure is designed with security in mind. Each component is carefully chosen for its security features, and the stack is modular, allowing you to add or remove components as needed. With NOWPayments, you can accept crypto payments securely, and convert them to USD in real-time.

Can I use this infrastructure to sell membership or subscription-based products?

Yes, you can use this infrastructure to sell membership or subscription-based products. With the Complete Builder Kit, you'll have everything you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack, including support for recurring payments.
